comment: WHERE releases and updates live, in one place. provider "github": {owner, repo} of the releases repository (must be PUBLIC for users' update checks to work). provider "generic": {url} of your own server or CDN folder that serves latest.yml, beta.yml and the installer. Acira uses the public metadata feed (same as the Mac build, packaging/update-feed.cjs): update.acirabrowser.com from beta.11 on (the GitHub raw feed older builds read stays as the fallback, desktop/browser-services/update-hosts.cjs); the application source repository stays private. Read by packaging/electron-builder.cjs (the installed app's app-update.yml), scripts/release.mjs, scripts/check-release-target.mjs and the spelling-dictionary mirror. docs/launch/PUBLIC_UPDATES.md.
